result.summary: Identified a spelling error in the search placeholder and text truncation on one of the store cards.

issues.description: Spelling mistake in search bar placeholder: 'Restarants' is used instead of 'Restaurants'.
The title 'Trattoria Piccolo' is truncated to 'Trattoria Piccol' due to container width limits.
issues.suggestion: Implement proper text wrapping or use an ellipsis to indicate overflow.
